emptyResponseError: {{provider}} returned an empty response. This usually means the API is misconfigured (base URL, model, or credentials).
emptyResponseErrorGeneric: The provider returned an empty response. This usually means the API is misconfigured (base URL, model, or credentials).
emptyResponseNoEvents: {{provider}} accepted the request but streamed no data at all. The upstream most likely dropped the response; if it keeps happening, check the base URL, model, and credentials.
emptyResponseUsageOnly: {{provider}} streamed only bookkeeping data (usage/queue) and no content. The request reached the model, so this is an upstream problem, not a local configuration error.
emptyResponseNamelessToolCall: {{provider}} announced a tool call without a tool name, so nothing could run. This is an upstream protocol fault.
emptyResponseStopWithoutContent: {{provider}} finished with "{{stopReason}}" but produced no content. The request reached the model, so this is an upstream problem, not a local configuration error.
reasoningOnlyExhausted: {{provider}} kept returning reasoning without an answer or tool call. This is a model-behaviour problem — try a different model or simplify the task.
cyberPolicyViolation: {{provider}} refused this request under its cyber-security policy (cyber_policy). The turn was terminated without retrying or switching accounts; sending similar content again may get the upstream account banned.
bufferPreservedNotice: Queued messages have been preserved. They will be sent automatically after a successful retry.
modelUnavailableWaitingDesc: {{model}} has no available credentials right now. Waiting for it to recover — you can interrupt to stop waiting.
quotaExhaustedWaitingDesc: {{model}} has used up its quota. Resuming automatically after the reset at {{resetAt}} — you can interrupt to stop waiting.
quotaExhaustedWaitNotPossible: Kimi quota exhausted. The allowance resets at {{resetAt}}, which is too far off to wait automatically — retry after that time.
quotaExhaustedWaitNotPossibleNoReset: Kimi quota exhausted, and the reset time could not be read. Retry after the allowance restores.

spec.title: Outline
spec.specGoalQueued: Queued — protected task will be added
spec.savedInterjected: Saved — will reach the narrator after the current tool call
spec.conflictMessage: File was modified externally. Reload to see changes.
spec.behaviorFenceEditHint: Write the constraints that must not be crossed here. The system will automatically remind the narrator. Only the user can edit this.
spec.fenceIntervalOn: Inject the behavior fence every {{count}} tool calls (skipped when the fence is empty)

spec.fenceAttachOff: Do not inject the behavior fence with the tasks reminder

spec.lockProtected: Mark as protected. Its content is locked; the assistant needs task reflection to complete or remove it.
spec.unlockConfirmMessage: This removes the protected flag so the task can be edited, completed, or deleted without task reflection. The assistant will still be reminded of your change.
spec.noTasks: No tasks yet. Add one to build the work plan.
spec.unsavedMessage: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and switch?

search.shortQuery: Type at least 2 characters to search.

visibilityHint.private: Only you and the people you share it with can open this session.
visibilityHint.project: Anyone working on this project can follow along.
visibilityHint.public: Any signed-in user can open this session.

writeAudienceHint.owner: Only you, admins, and people you individually grant "can drive" may send messages and approve tool calls.
writeAudienceHint.project: Project members with write access can send messages and approve tool calls, including running commands and editing files. Read-only members can still only watch.
writeAudienceHint.public: Any signed-in user who can reach this project can send messages and approve tool calls, including running commands and editing files.

writeAudienceBlocked.project: Driving requires seeing: set visibility above to Project or Everyone first.
writeAudienceBlocked.public: Driving requires seeing: set visibility above to Everyone first.

access.delegatedLink: Open the main session to change sharing
access.noOwner: This session predates access control and has no owner, so only an administrator can change its sharing. Ask one to transfer it to you.
access.readOnlyNotice: Only the owner or an administrator can change sharing.
access.unavailable: Sharing settings are unavailable for this session.
access.denied: You no longer have access to this session.

modelPrice.unavailable: No pricing information for this model.

humanAttentionDesc: Questions, permissions, plans and reflections waiting for a human decision. Counts cover loaded items only; + means more are available. Background subagents are grouped with their parent, but decisions go to the actual owner. Expand an item to review its full input.
humanAttentionEmpty: Nothing waiting for a human decision.
humanAttentionLoadError: Could not load human decisions. Please retry.
humanAttentionDecisionError: The decision was not confirmed. Your request and draft are kept; review and retry.
humanAttentionGone: This request has been handled, changed or is no longer visible. Refresh to check its current state.
humanAttentionTooLarge: This input is too large to review here. Approval is disabled; open the owning session to review the complete input.
humanAttentionUnavailable: The decision form is unavailable. Open the owning session to review it.
humanAttentionReadOnlyNotice: You can review this request, but you do not have permission to decide it.

optimizeFailedGeneric: An error occurred while optimizing the prompt
fullscreenHint: Ctrl+Enter to apply · Esc to cancel
